title: Suspension, Reopening and Closure of a Micro Market Agreement
content:
A client of the Unattended Micro Market Program may close the market off without ending the agreement, for a floor move, a building closure or a seasonal shutdown.

## When a suspension, resumption or closure is worked

A suspension, a resumption or a closure is only worked while the agreement stands active, suspended or closed, and a market still installing is abandoned rather than suspended. The standing and the first day of any closure are read from the company's records for that agreement before the work is taken up.

## Suspension

A suspension shorter than the minimum printed against the market format is handled as ordinary closed days, and suspended days accumulate against the contract year ceiling printed against the same format; once the ceiling is reached the client is asked either to reopen or to give notice. While suspended the standby charge printed against the market format replaces the equipment lease, and perishable stock is removed at the start of the suspension without charge.

## Reopening

Reopening needs the notice printed against the market format, counted in calendar days, so that the planogram can be rebuilt and the coolers restocked.

## Ending the agreement

Only the client may end the agreement, and the desk records the request as a termination notice for the client to confirm; notice is the number of calendar days printed against the market format.

Where the closure day falls before the end of the term, the early removal charge printed against the market format falls due, and on or after the end of the term it does not; the equipment removal charge printed against the format falls due either way.

| Closure day against the end of the term | Early removal charge | Equipment removal charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| before the end of the term | falls due | falls due |
| on the end of the term | does not fall due | falls due |
| after the end of the term | does not fall due | falls due |

On closure the subsidy funding left undrawn is refunded to the client on the final settlement rather than forfeited.
